name: omochi-ui-workspace

scripts.quickstart: bun run build && bun run build:native && bun run omochi-ui up --open examples/quickstart/omochi.toml
scripts.test: bun run build && bun run --bun --filter '*' test && bun run test:approval
scripts.test:approval: bun run build:native && tsc -p examples/agent-approval/tsconfig.json && bun test ./examples/agent-approval/test
scripts.test:native-mcp: cargo build --manifest-path packages/server-rust/Cargo.toml -p omochi-utils -p omochi-cli && OMOCHI_NATIVE_TEST=1 bun test packages/utils/test/native-mcp.test.ts
scripts.build:native: bun run --filter @omochi-ui/renderer build && bun run --filter @omochi-ui/hub-ui build && cargo build --manifest-path packages/server-rust/Cargo.toml --locked -p omochi-cli -p omochi-utils
scripts.test:native-renderer: cargo build --manifest-path packages/server-rust/Cargo.toml -p omochi-utils -p omochi-cli && OMOCHI_NATIVE_TEST=1 bun test packages/renderer/test/native.test.ts

description: Attach browser UIs to Python, TypeScript, and Rust programs with A2UI.
